update_interval.description: How often (in seconds) to refresh system info.

alignment.description: Text alignment in the terminal output.

font.description: Font string (required for config validity; ignored in CLI mode).

default_color.description: Default text color (ignored in CLI; kept for compatibility).

default_shade_color.description: Default shade color (ignored in CLI; kept for compatibility).

default_outline_color.description: Default outline color (ignored in CLI; kept for compatibility).

disks.description: Mountpoints to monitor for disk usage.

network_interfaces.description: Network interfaces to monitor (e.g., for incoming/outgoing traffic).

cpu_cpu_num.description: Number of CPUs to show individually. 0 = auto-detect.

show_swap.description: Whether to include swap usage in output.

max_user_text.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of user-defined text (output).

process_sort.description: Sort order for the process list.

show_user_processes.description: Whether to show processes for all users (not just the current user).

text_header.description: Static header line(s) shown once at top of output.

text_footer.description: Static footer line(s) shown once at bottom of output.

text_body.default:
${color}Hostname:${color} $nodename
${color}Uptime:${color} $uptime
${color}CPU:${color} ${cpu}% | ${cpugraph}
${color}Memory:${color} $mem / $memmax ($memperc%)
${color}Swap:${color} $swap / $swapmax ($swapperc%)
${color}Disk I/O:${color} ${diskio /}
${color}Network:${color} ${upspeed eth0} down / ${downspeed eth0} up
${color}Processes:${color} $processes ($running_processes running)
${color}Top CPU:${color}
${top name 1} (${top cpu 1}%) ${top mem 1}%
${top name 2} (${top cpu 2}%) ${top mem 2}%
${top name 3} (${top cpu 3}%) ${top mem 3}%
text_body.description: Main dynamic output section. Supports conky variables like $cpu, $mem, $nodename, etc. CLI mode only supports ${var} syntax, not ${alias}.
